_doc: Hub levels and hub buildings. [money] Parts are salvaged while scooping metal, plastic and glass junk (per compartment unit of that junk type; all three now give Parts). Costs: cubes + parts. Scooped parts are finite in a district (junk runs out; the recycler and Haggle make more), so level 4-5 and Air Scrubbers ask only for cubes plus what a district reliably yields; cubes keep coming from the garden stipend (hex_levels.json).

levels.name: Lean-to
levels.desc: Pipe frame, tin roof, a bench.

levels.name: Workshop
levels.desc: Walls, a roll-up door, floodlights. Bales sell for more at a proper scale.

levels.name: Depot Station
levels.desc: A second building, a radio mast and a sorting table.

levels.name: Solar Yard
levels.desc: Solar panels and a greenhouse frame. Power for bigger machines.

levels.name: Garden Station
levels.desc: A wind turbine, clean paint, planters, and a pad that could take a rocket.

buildings.name: Air Scrubber
buildings.desc: Pulls dusty air through filter banks. The sky clears faster.
